Riseup Labs is hiring 1 SQA Engineer Intern to join its Quality Assurance team. The internship offers hands-on experience in software testing, API testing, database validation and test automation alongside experienced QA engineers and development teams. No prior experience is specified.

## Responsibilities

- Execute manual functional, regression, smoke and UI tests on web and mobile applications.
- Create and maintain test cases and checklists based on requirements and user stories.
- Report reproducible bugs in Jira or a similar tool, including steps, screenshots and severity.
- Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing before releases.
- Test REST APIs with Postman and check responses against expected data.
- Use basic SQL queries to validate data integrity.
- Help write simple automation scripts using tools such as Selenium, Playwright or Cypress under guidance.

## Requirements

- A B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering from a reputed public or private university is required.
- Candidates must understand SDLC, STLC and basic testing types, including functional, regression and smoke testing.
- Candidates must be able to write clear test cases and bug reports.
- Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and good written and spoken English communication are required.

Preferred qualifications include:

- Hands-on experience with Postman, Jira or TestRail.
- Exposure to Selenium, Playwright or Cypress and a scripting language such as Java, Python or JavaScript.
- Familiarity with Git and Agile/Scrum.
- Academic or personal projects demonstrating testing work; GitHub links are welcome.
- Experience using AI tools to generate test cases, test data or automation scripts is a plus.

## Work arrangements

- This is an onsite internship in Uttara, Dhaka.
- Working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
- There are 2 weekly holidays: Saturday and Sunday.

## Salary and benefits

- The internship is paid; no salary amount is stated.
- Lunch is fully subsidized.
- Unlimited tea and coffee are provided.
- Benefits include celebrations of events and occasions, plus all public holidays declared by the Bangladesh Government.

## Hiring process

- A telephone round is followed by an interview with the QA Team Lead and Talent Acquisition Team.
- The final stage is a job offer.
- Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted during recruitment.

jobs.title: Senior SecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
SELISE Digital Platforms is hiring a Senior SecOps Engineer in Dhaka to protect its cloud and application environments. The role partners with engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to integrate security into software delivery and day-to-day operations.

## Responsibilities

- Operate and improve security monitoring and threat detection using Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM/SOAR, EDR, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, and related platforms.
- Investigate alerts, suspicious activity, and potential incidents, and lead or support containment, root-cause analysis, remediation, and incident response.
- Maintain Azure security controls covering IAM/RBAC, privileged access, service identities, Key Vault, secrets, networking, and access management.
- Secure AKS/Kubernetes clusters, Docker containers, cloud-native workloads, container images, networking, and secrets.
- Identify and prioritize vulnerabilities, track remediation, strengthen security configurations, respond to CVEs, and manage VAPT activities and penetration-testing remediation.
- Add security controls and automated checks to CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows, and build tools that reduce manual investigation and response work.
- Support Terraform/IaC security, policy-as-code, architecture reviews, and security-by-design across enterprise cloud platforms with multiple environments.
- Embed security requirements, reviews, testing, and risk mitigation throughout the enterprise application development lifecycle.
- Maintain security documentation, procedures, incident records, and audit evidence, and support ISO 27001 and GDPR controls.
- Work with developers, DevOps, architects, infrastructure teams, and management to communicate security risks and remediation priorities.

## Requirements

- You must have 5+ years of experience in Security Operations, Cloud Security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, or a related field.
- You must understand security operations, monitoring, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, CVEs, hardening, and remediation.
- You must have hands-on Azure security experience, knowledge of cloud security architecture, and practical experience with Microsoft Sentinel or another SIEM platform.
- You must have strong knowledge of IAM/RBAC, networking, identity, privileged access, secrets management, Key Vault, and access controls.
- You must have experience securing Kubernetes/AKS, Docker containers, cloud-native workloads, and container images.
- You must be able to interpret VAPT and penetration-testing findings and drive practical remediation.
- You must understand DevSecOps, secure SDLC, CI/CD security integration, Terraform/IaC security, and policy-as-code.
- You must have scripting and automation skills in Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar tools.
- You must understand ISO 27001 and GDPR security controls and be familiar with SIEM/SOAR, EDR, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, and security automation platforms.
- You must take a proactive, security-first approach to identifying and resolving risks, with an emphasis on automation.
- You must have strong analytical, incident-management, communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to explain incidents, risks, and remediation priorities clearly.
- Relevant cloud or security certifications, such as Azure Security Engineer, Security Operations, or equivalent credentials, are an advantage.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, permanent position based in Dhaka.

## Salary and benefits

- SELISE offers a competitive salary and opportunities for career growth.
- You will work with supportive peers and mentors in a collaborative engineering environment.
- The role offers participation in innovation initiatives, architecture discussions, and technical leadership, with room to experiment and make an impact.
- Learning opportunities include training, knowledge sharing, and hands-on challenges.
- Team-building events and recreational activities are available.

jobs.title: Shelter Engineer
jobs.description:

## Responsibilities

- Maintain a regular field presence through risk-based visits, joint inspections and spot checks. Assess construction progress, workmanship, materials, safety and technical risks against approved designs, specifications, standards and programme requirements.
- Document quality concerns, implementation constraints and deviations. Follow up corrective actions with BDRCS or implementing teams and promptly escalate unresolved or high-risk issues.
- Verify key milestones, completed works, handover documentation and readiness for technical acceptance. Provide independent recommendations within delegated authority, while maintaining the distinction between IFRC assurance and BDRCS’s responsibility for day-to-day implementation.
- Help review construction and settlement plans, schedules, targets and resource needs. Assess site surveys, drawings, bills of quantities, specifications, work plans and procurement or tender documents for feasibility, accuracy, compliance and suitable technical evaluation criteria.
- Compare reported achievements with site conditions, plans and supporting evidence. Check construction, labour, material and delivery records for completeness and consistency, and flag discrepancies, delays or quality issues.

Therap (BD) Ltd. is hiring 2 Associate Training and Content Specialists for full-time positions in Banani, Dhaka. The role involves creating training and support content, helping customers understand technical issues, and contributing customer insights to product development.

## Responsibilities

- Write user guides, release notes, and other support materials.
- Create innovative web-based tutorials.
- Explain complex technical issues to customers.
- Share customer feedback with software development teams to support product improvements.
- Prepare responses to RFPs and other business proposals.

## Requirements

- You must have excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
- You must demonstrate creative and analytical writing skills.
- You should be eager to explore, learn about, and critically assess emerging technologies for practical business use.
- You must be familiar with commonly used AI tools and platforms.
- You must have strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
- A bachelor’s degree in CS, CSE, EEE, English Literature, or a similar field is preferred.

## Work arrangements

- These are full-time positions based in Banani, Dhaka.

## Salary and benefits

- Benefits are provided according to company policy.

jobs.title: Training and Implementation Associate
jobs.description:
Therap (BD) Ltd. is seeking a Training and Implementation Associate to support clients, deliver training, and coordinate project implementation. The role also involves reporting, outreach, and testing technologies that improve productivity and client services.

## Responsibilities

- Manage client relationships and help ensure successful project implementation.
- Design and deliver online and onsite training on various solutions, and provide ongoing technical support and guidance.
- Create training and support materials.
- Analyze training effectiveness, prepare performance reports, and turn findings into actionable insights.
- Reach out proactively to potential clients and explain the value of the company’s services.
- Develop marketing materials and organize promotional conferences, workshops, and information sessions.
- Explore and pilot new technologies, including AI and Machine Learning tools, to improve internal productivity and client service delivery.

## Requirements

- Hold a bachelor’s degree in IT, Business, Disability Studies, Education, or a related field. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
- Have strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Bangla.
- Demonstrate an interest in data analysis using spreadsheets and basic dashboards, and a proven ability to use AI/GenAI tools for research and content creation.
- Be proficient in digital marketing, social media, teaching, and public speaking.
- Have strong computer skills and an eagerness to learn new cloud technologies.

## Work arrangements

- Be willing to travel for work when needed.

jobs.title: Associate Oncall Engineer
jobs.description:
Therap (BD) Ltd. is hiring an Associate Oncall Engineer to help maintain the reliability of its critical systems. The role involves monitoring infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, coordinating incident resolution, and improving operational processes. The systems use technologies from Oracle, VMware, F5, Fortigate, Cisco, and NetApp.

## Responsibilities

- Monitor infrastructure on a 24x7x365 basis, tracking system performance, server health, network traffic, and application status.
- Diagnose and resolve issues within the role’s scope using knowledge of system administration, network engineering, and application support.
- Coordinate with other teams during incidents, escalate issues when necessary, and document incidents comprehensively.
- Regularly review and update monitoring configurations, alert thresholds, and escalation procedures as infrastructure and applications change.

## Requirements

- A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required.
- A basic understanding of Linux operating systems and the command-line interface is required.
- Candidates must be familiar with monitoring and diagnostic tools, including log analyzers, performance monitoring applications, and network analysis tools.
- Candidates must have troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, strong communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
- Candidates must be willing to work shifts and undertake oncall duties as required.

## Work arrangements

- Shift work provides 24x7x365 coverage and includes nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Availability for oncall duties is required.

jobs.title: Experienced React Developer
jobs.description:
Therap (BD) Ltd. is hiring an Experienced React Developer to build reliable, high-performance web application interfaces and collaborate with backend developers.

## Responsibilities

- Build modern, responsive, cross-browser-compatible web application frontends using React, CSS, and HTML.
- Work with backend developers to create frontend UI components that connect to REST APIs.

## Requirements

- Hold a B.Sc or M.Sc in CSE or have a similar academic background.
- Have at least 2 years of React development experience.
- Demonstrate good knowledge of programming, data structures, and frontend application architecture and design.
- Have strong HTML and CSS skills.
- Have experience with JavaScript libraries such as jQuery and Bootstrap.
- Have experience with JavaScript build tools such as Webpack, and development tools such as Git and NPM.

jobs.title: DevOps Administrator
jobs.description:
Therap (BD) Ltd. is hiring a DevOps Administrator with 1–3 years of experience for a hands-on role supporting and improving production environments. The work focuses on Linux administration, Java application troubleshooting, and practical SRE approaches to reliability and performance.

## Responsibilities

- Manage Linux systems, including daily administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and basic security hardening.
- Support Java-based applications and their web and application servers.
- Maintain and improve CI/CD build and deployment pipelines, automating repetitive tasks where possible.
- Investigate deployment failures, performance problems, and unexpected system behavior using logs and metrics to identify root causes.
- Write and maintain scripts, primarily in Bash, with Python where appropriate.
- Participate in production releases and handle off-hours issues when required, with support duties shared across the team.

## Requirements

- A B.Sc. in CSE, EEE, or a related technical field is required.
- Candidates must have 1–3 years of experience in DevOps, system administration, or a similar role.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and confidence using the command line are required.
- Candidates need practical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
- A basic understanding of JVM-based applications is required, including memory usage, logs, and common failure patterns.
- Candidates should be willing to learn, take ownership, and persist through technical problems.

Preferred qualifications:

- Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or similar container technologies is desirable; home lab experience counts.
- Experience with monitoring or observability tools such as Prometheus or Grafana is preferred.
- Experience supporting production systems and familiarity with modern DevOps practices are desirable.

## Work arrangements

- Off-hours production support may be required, with responsibilities shared across the team.

## Salary and benefits

- The role offers experience with live production systems, a supportive team, and opportunities to develop further in DevOps engineering.
